profile_text.body:
Adobe is a for-profit public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, trading on the public markets under the ticker ADBE. Its most recently filed 10-K reported revenue of $23,769,000,000 for the period ending November 28, 2025. The company's website for the profile entry is Adobe Express, which the site describes as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool aimed at making content creation easy, with uses including social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe tracks several AI products across design, video, and audio categories. Adobe Express AI is a lightweight design tool with integration into Adobe Firefly, Adobe's image generation model, both of which the company describes as trained on data it characterizes as commercially safe. Premiere Pro AI extends those capabilities into professional video editing, offering features the site describes as generative extend and color match, also under a commercially safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI is positioned for audio work, offering speech enhancement and a microphone check feature, again with a commercially safe training claim attached. Within Adobe Express, the company describes an AI Assistant 2 that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements across layers.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for Adobe.
